title: Silesian German language
description: Language spoken in Lower Silesia, or German dialect
extract: Silesian, Silesian German, Schlasian or Lower Silesian is a nearly extinct German dialect spoken in Silesia. It is part of the East Central German language area with some West Slavic and Lechitic influences. Silesian German emerged as the result of Late Medieval German migration to Silesia, which had been inhabited by Lechitic or West Slavic peoples in the Early Middle Ages.
